name: Análisis de Marcha
algorithm: Gait Analysis — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes gait (walking) patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **Pose Sequence Extracción**: Full-body pose estimation tracks joint positions (ankles, knees, hips, shoulders, head) across frames during walking motion. The gait cycle is decomposed into phases: stance (foot on ground), swing (foot in air), heel strike, and toe-off.

2. **Gait Biomechanical Análisis**: Human gait follows predictable biomechanical patterns: (a) periodic joint angle trajectories, (b) characteristic ground reaction force profiles, (c) coordinated upper-lower body motion (arm swing opposing leg swing). The method verifies these biomechanical constraints. AI-generated walking may violate gait physics.

3. **Individual Gait Signature**: Each person has a characteristic gait determined by body proportions, musculoskeletal dynamics, and habitual patterns. Gait features (stride length/frequency ratio, knee flexion amplitude, hip sway) form an individual signature. Face-swap deepfakes may show mismatched gait-face identity.

4. **Temporal Regularity Análisis**: Gait is quasi-periodic with characteristic cycle duration (1-1.2s at normal speed). The method analyzes gait cycle regularity via autocorrelation. AI-generated walking motion may show irregular periodicity, missing the subtle natural variations in gait timing.

5. **Físico Constraint Puntuación**: The method checks multiple physical constraints simultaneously: center of mass trajectory follows ballistic parabola during swing phase, ground contact produces consistent foot placement, joint angles remain within anatomical limits. Violations indicate AI generation that hasn't properly modeled multi-body dynamics.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante gait analysis analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
